question: What request did the serpent-king make to the pleased Bhairava?
premises: After long worship, the serpent-king addressed the pleased lord.
He said he was unable to stay in his own netherworld during the rains.
The supreme lord then responded to him.
inference: The serpent-king sought refuge from the supreme lord because he could not endure the rainy season in his own realm.
uncertainties: The verse ends mid-response, so the lord's action is completed only in the next verse.
plain_english: He then appealed to the pleased lord, saying that he was unable to remain in his own netherworld during the rains. The supreme lord responded to him.
